sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (3.7 years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (319), and recession signals create highly unfavourable conditions for financials despite distant earnings event.
